description: §22.12 (S459 round 4 F1) — `for` on `<label>` in runtime `meta.emit` output is refused: a label click is a click on the page element its `for` names. Nothing written.
rationale: §22.12 *Attributes*: `for` on `<label>` is on no list — like `popovertarget` / `commandfor`, "they act on another element of the page by id"; on a violation the gate SHALL write NOTHING. (S459 round 4, PA decisions on the S459 final review — bryan "go")
